newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold closes steady, silver falls.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold closes steady, silver falls.

text.p: ** Gold 24 carat closed unchanged at 4,750 rupees per 10 gramme. ** Gold was down by 40 rupees per 10 gramme during last week as wedding season demand low.
** Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) closed steady at 55,500 rupees per piece after losing 600 rupees last week.

** Silver (.999) closed 10 rupees lower at 6,795 rupees per kg against the previous close of 6,805 rupees but up 15 rupees per kg against today's opening level of 6,780 rupees as early declines drew in industrial buying.
